purpose: Fail closed when a direct software dependency surface changes without an explicit offline/deployment policy update.

dotnet.developmentOffline: Prepare-MaviDeveloperOfflineCache.ps1 captures the NuGet restore closure used by the solution.
dotnet.productionOffline: dotnet publish produces the self-contained application dependency closure required by the deployed MAVI web host; the ASP.NET Core 10 Hosting Bundle is carried in the setup media.
dotnet.changeRule: Any PackageReference addition/version change must update this policy and prove offline restore/publish in CI or disconnected qualification as applicable.

npm.developmentOffline: The canonical developer cache carries npm cache content and Setup runs npm ci --offline.
npm.productionOffline: Frontend dependencies are compiled into local static assets during publish; production does not execute npm or load CDN assets.
npm.changeRule: Any dependency/devDependency change must update package-lock.json and this policy, then pass frontend test/typecheck/build and offline-cache preparation.

python.developmentOffline: The canonical developer cache carries a Python wheelhouse and Setup installs the Development environment with --no-index.
python.productionOffline: Vision runtime dependencies are bound to platform-specific offline runtime locks/bundles and qualification evidence; no first-run downloads are permitted.
python.changeRule: Any Python dependency or build-system change must update this policy and the applicable offline wheel/runtime lock/bundle plus qualification evidence.

cudaAcquisition.rule: Use the dedicated cu124 index, never --extra-index-url, and freeze exact wheel SHA-256 values before offline use.

nativeAndToolchain.verification: SHA-256 manifest, PostgreSQL 18 executable version, pgvector availability/extension check
nativeAndToolchain.licenceHandling: LICENSE-POSTGRESQL.txt and LICENSE-PGVECTOR.txt retained in the runtime pack

nativeAndToolchain.verification: manifest SHA-256 plus executable/version viability before serving requests
nativeAndToolchain.licenceHandling: FFmpeg licence/notices retained with the application payload

nativeAndToolchain.verification: ASP.NET Core 10 runtime and IIS ASP.NET Core Module V2 are verified after installation
nativeAndToolchain.licenceHandling: approved Microsoft redistributable retained as controlled release input

nativeAndToolchain.verification: .NET 10 SDK, Node.js 22.13+, Python 3.13 and npm are checked after installation
nativeAndToolchain.licenceHandling: approved vendor installers are controlled release inputs

nativeAndToolchain.verification: offline restore/install followed by .NET build, frontend build and Python tests
nativeAndToolchain.licenceHandling: dependency licences remain governed by their upstream packages; release preparation must retain any redistribution notices required by a newly added package

nativeAndToolchain.setupIntegration: Task-17 runtime qualification and deployment tooling
nativeAndToolchain.verification: runtime locks, hashes, model manifest relationships and disconnected CPU/CUDA qualification
nativeAndToolchain.licenceHandling: model/runtime licence approval is required before promotion

nativeAndToolchain.packagedAs: external operating-system prerequisite; not silently bundled in a Vision Runtime Pack
nativeAndToolchain.setupIntegration: Vision worker/runtime preflight validates the installed NVIDIA driver before CUDA execution
nativeAndToolchain.verification: nvidia-smi identity plus a minimum driver requirement frozen with the qualified CUDA Runtime Pack before hardware qualification
nativeAndToolchain.licenceHandling: NVIDIA driver redistribution, if ever added to MAVI media, requires separate licence approval; current policy treats it as externally installed

nativeAndToolchain.packagedAs: build-only; explicitly excluded from Development Runtime Pack and Production media
nativeAndToolchain.setupIntegration: C2 CUDA wheel build environment only
nativeAndToolchain.verification: nvcc --version plus a trivial .cu compilation against the selected MSVC toolset; exact toolkit identity captured in nativeAbi
nativeAndToolchain.licenceHandling: CUDA Toolkit redistribution is not implied; any cached installer/build image requires NVIDIA licence review

nativeAndToolchain.packagedAs: build-only; excluded from Vision Runtime Pack and Production media
nativeAndToolchain.setupIntegration: C2 MMCV CUDA wheel build environment only
nativeAndToolchain.verification: exact VCToolsVersion and WindowsSDKVersion captured before build; toolset frozen only after CUDA 12.4 host-compiler preflight
nativeAndToolchain.licenceHandling: Microsoft build-tool licensing applies to the controlled build environment; no compiler payload is distributed with the Runtime Pack

nativeAndToolchain.setupIntegration: CUDA Runtime Pack installation/repair must verify the required VC runtime before loading MMCV native extensions
nativeAndToolchain.verification: signed installer identity plus an import/load smoke test for mmcv native ops on the installed runtime
nativeAndToolchain.licenceHandling: approved Microsoft Visual C++ redistributable retained as a controlled prerequisite if packaging is required

requiredChangeReview: Justify why the new dependency is needed and prefer the existing standard library/framework when reasonable.
Classify it as build-only, development/test, application runtime, native runtime, model/runtime, or operating-system prerequisite.
Update this dependency policy snapshot for every direct .NET, npm or Python dependency change.
Update the offline cache/bundle/staging path for anything needed on a disconnected Development or Production machine.
Retain required licences/notices and add hash/version verification for native binaries or external payloads.
Update Setup/repair and Test-MaviEnvironment when the target machine needs a new installed/runtime prerequisite.
Add or update tests and disconnected qualification evidence appropriate to the dependency's scope.
Update local-development, offline-setup, offline-readiness and release/acceptance documentation when operator or release preparation steps change.
Do not add runtime Internet downloads, CDN assets, online activation/licence checks, remote telemetry, or undeclared PATH dependencies.
